description: Minimalist, easy-to-host service for sharing images and other files.

promotion.reason: Withheld pending real managed Windows file-sharing, passphrase refusal, expiration and persistence qualification, then an explicit reviewed promotion decision. Source license and image pin were reviewed on October 1, 2026.

data_storage: A Docker volume Local Store manages for picoshare
risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in a Docker volume that Local Store manages for it. A keep-data uninstall leaves the volume; deleting data removes it permanently.
Not qualified on the Local Store managed engine. This withheld proposal is not installable from the catalog.
Choose an administrator passphrase before installing. Local Store keeps it with private setup answers; the app uses it to authorize uploads and management.
Anyone who has a shared file link can download that file without an administrator session until it expires or is deleted. Keep private links private.
No cloud replication is configured. Data remains in the owned local volume.

The official v1.5.4 Dockerfile uses Alpine 3.15, whose normal support ended November 1, 2023. Alpine lists it as on-request support only. A recent app release does not establish maintained operating-system packages; an explicit maintenance review is needed before promotion. No vulnerability scan or patched-base proof is claimed.
